//: Runtime tsconfig for `tsx` when running local scripts (e.g. seo:backfill). It aliases the `server-only` bare specifier — which Next resolves at build time but plain Node/tsx cannot — to a no-op stub, so server-only modules (the SEO client + admin client) can be imported by a standalone script. The root tsconfig is unchanged, so Next's real client/server guard is preserved. Typechecking still uses the root tsconfig.
